    global_var:oe_y7_m >= oe_y7_hi_5
    oe_y7_can_5 = yes
}
oe_y7_lapse_5 = {
    oe_y7_s_known = yes
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_5 }
    OR = {
        global_var:oe_y7_phase >= 2
        AND = {
            global_var:oe_y7_m >= oe_y7_hi_5
            OR = {
                NOT = { oe_y7_can_5 = yes }
                global_var:oe_y7_m > oe_y7_cut_5
            }
        }
    }
}

# ---- phase 3, first batch "孛罗之乱" (v6.6 y7-sup3a): Bolod Temür, Köke Temür, W-1, .25
# Any scope. Bolod Temür (made by oe_y7_make_bolod, script = oe_y7_bolod) is alive and at the Yuan court.
oe_y7_bolod_ok = {
    character:oe_y7_bolod ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI }
}
# Any scope. Bolod Temür heads the Yuan cabinet (as oe_y7_toqto_in_charge reads Toqto'a).
oe_y7_bolod_head = {
    character:oe_y7_bolod ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI in_cabinet = yes has_character_modifier = head_of_the_cabinet_modifier }
}
# Any scope (interface, design 4.2). Bolod Temür rules the court: in power after .26 (3) or kept by .27 b (7), and still
# the head of the cabinet.
oe_y7_bolod_in_power = {
    OR = { global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 3 global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 7 }
    oe_y7_bolod_head = yes
}
# Any scope. Köke Temür (vanilla red_turban_rebellions.16, character cko_temur_koke) rules the warlord state CKO and is
# not at war with the Yuan (case 甲: allegiance and opinion can be changed).
oe_y7_koke_lord = {
    exists = character:cko_temur_koke
    country_exists = c:CKO
    c:CKO = { ruler ?= character:cko_temur_koke NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:CHI } }
}
# Any scope. Köke Temür is alive at the Yuan court (case 乙: the Yuan did not let CKO go).
oe_y7_koke_court = {
    character:cko_temur_koke ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI }
}
# Any scope. Case 甲 or 乙 (neither: case 丙, the texts leave Köke Temür out).
oe_y7_koke_any = {
    OR = {
        oe_y7_koke_lord = yes
        oe_y7_koke_court = yes
    }
}
# Any scope. World step W-1 may happen this month (design 3.6): phase 2, 12 months after the first month seen in phase
# 2, months 303-344 (1362.7-1365.12), Toqto'a not in charge, Chaghan Temür not at the Yuan court, the Yuan owning and
# controlling Datong, no Bianliang campaign.
oe_y7_w1_can = {
    oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes
    global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 2
    has_global_variable = oe_y7_c3_m0
    global_var:oe_y7_m >= oe_y7_w1_from
    global_var:oe_y7_m >= 303
    global_var:oe_y7_m <= 344
    oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = no
    NOT = { character:oe_y7_chaghan ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } }
    location:datong_datong = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI }
    NOT = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 3 }
}

# Any scope. Event 25 (phase 3): open (inside its window after W-1), due (end reached), lapse (dropped: Bolod Temür no
# longer at Datong, or the window and its grace are over).
oe_y7_open_25 = {
    has_global_variable = oe_y7_w1_m
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_25 }
    global_var:oe_y7_m >= oe_y7_lo_25
    global_var:oe_y7_m < oe_y7_hi_25
    oe_y7_can_25 = yes
}

    has_global_variable = oe_y7_w1_m
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_25 }
    global_var:oe_y7_m >= oe_y7_hi_25
    oe_y7_can_25 = yes
}
oe_y7_lapse_25 = {
    has_global_variable = oe_y7_w1_m
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_25 }
    OR = {
        NOT = { global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 1 }
        AND = {
            global_var:oe_y7_m >= oe_y7_hi_25

            }
        }
    }
}

# ---- phase 3, second batch "河南王与关中" (v6.6 y7-sup3b): Li Siqi, .28, W-2, .19
# Any scope. Li Siqi (vanilla red_turban_rebellions.15, character csi_siqi_li) rules the warlord state CSI and is not at
# war with the Yuan (case 甲: allegiance and opinion can be changed).
oe_y7_siqi_lord = {
    exists = character:csi_siqi_li
    country_exists = c:CSI
    c:CSI = { ruler ?= character:csi_siqi_li NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:CHI } }
}
# Any scope. Li Siqi is alive at the Yuan court (case 乙: the Yuan did not let CSI go).
oe_y7_siqi_court = {
    character:csi_siqi_li ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI }
}
# Any scope. Case 甲 or 乙 (neither: the texts say "the Guanzhong generals" and nothing is done to Li Siqi).
oe_y7_siqi_any = {
    OR = {
        oe_y7_siqi_lord = yes
        oe_y7_siqi_court = yes
    }
}
# Any scope. The month of .28 has come: oe_y7_d_28 (set by the first batch) is reached; or, without it, month 343
# (1365.11) once the first batch has closed (W-1 never came, or Bolod Temür died, left or could not be made).
oe_y7_28_ready = {
    has_global_variable = oe_y7_m
    OR = {
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_d_28 global_var:oe_y7_m >= global_var:oe_y7_d_28 }
        AND = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_d_28 }
            global_var:oe_y7_m >= 343
            OR = {
                AND = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod } global_var:oe_y7_st_25 ?= 2 }
                global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 4
                global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 5
                global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 9
            }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope. World step W-2 may happen (design 3.7): Köke Temür's CKO and Li Siqi's CSI both exist, are run by the AI, are
# nobody's subjects and are not at war with each other.
oe_y7_w2_can = {
    country_exists = c:CKO
    country_exists = c:CSI
    c:CKO = { is_ai = yes is_subject = no NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:CSI } }
    c:CSI = { is_ai = yes is_subject = no }
}

# Any scope. Event 19 (phase 3, second batch): open (inside its fixed window, months 318-329), due (end reached), lapse

# ---- phase 3, third batch "大都与尾声" (v6.7 y7-sup3c)
# Any scope. The Yuan holds Dadu as its capital: owns and controls the location, and its capital is Dadu (vanilla's form,
# flavor_chi.txt).
oe_y7_dadu_capital = {
    country_exists = c:CHI
    location:dadu = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI }
    c:CHI = { capital ?= location:dadu }
}
# Any scope. The capital is pressed this month (design 3.8): the Yuan holds Dadu as its capital and is at war, and Dadu is
# besieged or an enemy at war with the Yuan controls a Yuan location of the Shuntian, Tongzhou or Changping provinces
# ("明兵至通州", 卷47). TEST: global oe_y7_t_press (button y73press) stands for the war part.
oe_y7_dadu_pressed = {
    oe_y7_dadu_capital = yes
    OR = {
        has_global_variable = oe_y7_t_press
        AND = {
            c:CHI = { at_war = yes }
            OR = {
                location:dadu = { has_siege = yes }
                province_definition:shuntian_province = { any_location_in_province_definition = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= { is_at_war_with = c:CHI } } } province_definition:tongzhou_beizhili_province = { any_location_in_province_definition = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= { is_at_war_with = c:CHI } } } province_definition:changping_province = { any_location_in_province_definition = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= { is_at_war_with = c:CHI } } }
            }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope. Dadu has fallen (design 3.8): the Yuan no longer owns it, or has not controlled it 2 months in a row
# (global oe_y7_lost). TEST: global oe_y7_t_fall (button y73fall).
oe_y7_dadu_fallen = {
    OR = {
        has_global_variable = oe_y7_t_fall
        NOT = { location:dadu = { owner ?= c:CHI } }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_lost global_var:oe_y7_lost >= 2 }
    }
}
# Any scope. .32 can be decided: the city fell, or (after .31 b) campaign 4 "守大都" was won.
oe_y7_dadu_decided = {
    OR = {
        oe_y7_dadu_fallen = yes
        AND = { global_var:oe_y7_dadu ?= 2 global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 4 has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done global_var:oe_y7_camp_ok ?= 1 }
    }
}
# Any scope. World step W-3 may happen (design 3.8): from month 364 (1367.8), the Prince of Xuanrang alive at the Yuan
# court and not yet Prince of Huai, in phase 2 or the epilogue.
oe_y7_w3_can = {
    oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_huai }
    OR = { global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 2 has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi }
    global_var:oe_y7_m >= 364
    character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI }
}
# Any scope (interface, design 4.2). The epilogue runs (after the line closed at 1385.1.1; oe_y7_running is no then).
oe_y7_epilogue = {
    has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi
}
# Any scope. Some event of the epilogue is due (a due event waits at most two busy months).
oe_y7_epi_any_due = {
    OR = {
        oe_y7_due_31 = yes
        oe_y7_due_32 = yes
        oe_y7_due_30 = yes
        oe_y7_due_28 = yes
        oe_y7_due_29 = yes
    }
}
